_note: Round 44: ruins and the old age. A dig site on every dungeon floor from the fourth down, placed at runtime. The deeper you dig, the older the age: the Long Quiet near the top, the First Breath near the Heart. Each relic adds a line to the Old Age timeline (the World page). Find every relic of an age and you learn a technique from it. Relics can be kept, or given to the Heirs or the Sects (they each want them, and each resents the other getting them). Words are Dev's to rewrite (brief ruins).

fragment.name: Old Age potsherd
fragment.desc: A shard of glazed pot with a glyph on it. Traders buy them; scholars want them more.

eras.name: The First Breath
eras.summary: Cultivators found qi rising from a heart deep under the mountains, and went down to meet it.

technique.name: Breath of the First Cultivators
technique.desc: The way the first cultivators breathed at the Heart: slow, deep, all the way down.

eras.inscription: WE WENT DOWN TO WHERE THE BREATH BEGINS

eras.name: The Lattice Age
eras.summary: The Makers, cultivators who were also artificers, built the swarm at the Heart to carry qi up to heaven.

technique.name: Lattice Sympathy
technique.desc: You understand the swarm the way its Makers did. It works faster for you.

eras.inscription: A LADDER OF SMALL HANDS, REACHING UP

eras.name: The Sundering
eras.summary: Heaven did not answer. The Lattice broke, the deep twisted into its floors, and the Makers' people scattered.

technique.name: Sundered Ward
technique.desc: The Makers' last defence, rebuilt from their broken plans. Blows land softer.

eras.inscription: THE LADDER FELL AND THE DEEP CLOSED OVER IT

eras.name: The Long Quiet
eras.summary: The deep slept. Clans took it, refugees settled it, and the stair under the well was forgotten until it ran dry.

technique.name: Patience of the Quiet
technique.desc: The deep's people learned to wait and to heal. So have you.

eras.inscription: WE WAITED. WE ARE STILL HERE.

quiet_hearthstone.name: Soot-black hearthstone
quiet_hearthstone.desc: A flat stone blackened by a thousand fires.
quiet_hearthstone.text: The first Deepfolk came down a stair that was already old. They found empty halls and lit fires in them. This stone held one of the first.

clan_tally_stick.name: Clan tally stick
clan_tally_stick.desc: Notches cut in bone, in groups of seven.
clan_tally_stick.text: The Hollow Clans counted their beasts on sticks like this. The oldest stick has one notch. Someone came down with a single beast and built a clan.

sealed_well_cap.name: Iron well-cap
sealed_well_cap.desc: A heavy iron lid stamped with a rising sun.
sealed_well_cap.text: Someone sealed the stair under Eliet's well, from below, a long time ago. The seal held until the water dropped and the lid rusted through.

refugee_shoe.name: Child's leather shoe
refugee_shoe.text: Families fled down after the Sundering, not up. The surface was worse. They made the deep a home because there was nowhere else.

sect_banner_scrap.name: Burnt sect banner
sect_banner_scrap.desc: Silk, scorched, with half a lotus on it.
sect_banner_scrap.text: The sects came down once, centuries ago, to burn the swarm out. They failed. The ones who survived went home and wrote that the deep was cursed.

candle_mould.name: Stone candle mould
candle_mould.desc: Six candle shapes cut into one block.
candle_mould.text: Light was the first trade in the deep. Whoever made light could buy anything. Tallowmark is still proud of it.

cracked_conduit.name: Cracked qi conduit
cracked_conduit.desc: A pipe of jade and metal, split down its length.
cracked_conduit.text: The Lattice carried qi through conduits like this, up from the Heart. On the night of the Sundering every one of them cracked at once.

makers_last_order.name: Tablet of the last order
makers_last_order.desc: A stone tablet. One line, carved in a hurry.
makers_last_order.text: The Makers' last order reads: 'Let the small hands go. Seal the Heart.' The swarm was set loose. It's been looking for something to do ever since.

melted_tower_bell.name: Melted tower bell
melted_tower_bell.desc: A bronze bell, slumped like wax.
melted_tower_bell.text: The Makers' towers rose from the Heart toward the surface. When the Lattice broke, they burned from the inside. The Bonefire Moot was lit that same night.

twisted_map.name: Twisted map
twisted_map.desc: A map of straight halls that no longer exist.
twisted_map.text: Before the Sundering the deep was a straight shaft with halls on each side. Afterwards it folded into floors, each one strange. This map shows the old shape.

heirs_oath_ring.name: Heir's oath ring
heirs_oath_ring.desc: A plain ring stamped with a ladder.
heirs_oath_ring.text: The Makers who survived swore to finish the ladder one day. Their children still wear the ring. That's who the Heirs are.

silenced_bell_rope.name: Frayed bell rope
silenced_bell_rope.desc: A braided rope, cut clean through.
silenced_bell_rope.text: The sect cultivators who worked with the Makers cut the bell ropes and left. Their children founded the Valley Sects, and never forgave the swarm.

lattice_node.name: Dormant lattice node
lattice_node.desc: A crystal the size of a fist. Something moves inside it, very slowly.
lattice_node.text: A lattice node held a thousand nanites in sleep, waiting for qi. The Makers set millions of them along the shaft, a ladder of small hands.

makers_tool.name: Maker's fine tool
makers_tool.desc: A jade handle with a tip too fine to see.
makers_tool.text: The Makers built nanites one by one at first, by hand, in meditation. A Maker could spend a year on one. Then the nanites learned to build each other.

ladder_blueprint.name: Ladder blueprint
ladder_blueprint.desc: Silk drawn with lines finer than hair.
ladder_blueprint.text: The plan was simple: a chain of nanites from the Heart to the sky. Qi would climb it. A cultivator would climb with the qi, all the way to heaven.

first_swarm_jar.name: Sealed swarm jar
first_swarm_jar.desc: A glass jar. The dust inside turns to face you.
first_swarm_jar.text: The first swarm was kept in a jar like this. It could heal a cut, carry a whisper, warm a room. The Makers thought it was a toy. It was the beginning.

choir_score.name: Choir score
choir_score.desc: Pages of music with no words.
choir_score.text: The Makers sang to their machines. Tone told a nanite what to do. The Lattice Choir still sings some of the old songs and doesn't know what half of them mean.

makers_mirror.name: Maker's mirror
makers_mirror.desc: Polished silver. Your reflection blinks a moment late.
makers_mirror.text: The Makers tested the swarm by having it copy them. The mirror floors began here. The deep has been copying whoever goes deepest ever since.

heart_shard.name: Warm stone shard
heart_shard.text: The first cultivators found the Heart by its warmth. Qi rose from it like heat from a forge. They called it the First Breath.

breath_carving.name: Breathing carving
breath_carving.desc: A figure carved sitting, with lines drawn in and out of its chest.
breath_carving.text: The oldest way of breathing qi was learned here, by sitting near the Heart and copying its rhythm. In, slow. Out, slower.

first_stair_stone.name: First stair stone
first_stair_stone.desc: A step worn into a curve by feet.
first_stair_stone.text: The stair under Eliet's well was cut by the first cultivators, going down. Every step of it is older than any sect in the valley.

pilgrim_bowl.name: Pilgrim's bowl
pilgrim_bowl.desc: A clay bowl with a name scratched in it that nobody can read.
pilgrim_bowl.text: Pilgrims came from far away to sit at the Heart. Most stayed a season. A few stayed for life and became the first masters.

unbroken_seal.name: Unbroken seal
unbroken_seal.desc: A seal of red stone, intact, with no door around it.
unbroken_seal.text: The first masters sealed the Heart's chamber when they died, to keep it pure. The Makers broke that seal. Everything after began there.

first_masters_words.name: The first master's words
first_masters_words.desc: A jade slip. The words are simple.
first_masters_words.text: 'Heaven is not up. It is in. The breath goes all the way down.' The Makers built a ladder to the sky because they never read this.
